nodes.label: Reasoner AI Reasoning Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Production-grade AI reasoning orchestrator that decomposes complex problems into structured multi-phase pipelines with parallel LLM execution, critique, and synthesis.

nodes.label: ReasonerPipeline
nodes.rationale: Main orchestrator running classification, decomposition, context vetting, deep read, flow dispatch, synthesis, and optional verification.

nodes.label: HyperGate Pre-Routing
nodes.rationale: 6 parallel sub-agents detect language, complexity, directness, web need, and optimal method before pipeline execution.

nodes.label: Hexagonal Architecture
nodes.rationale: Domain depends on protocols, not concrete implementations. Documented layer violations exist: domain/preset_core imports infrastructure/llm/registry, application/flows imports api/serializers, and api/streaming directly instantiates ReasonerPipeline.

nodes.label: Mixin Pattern
nodes.rationale: 14 method-specific mixins compose behaviors into ReasonerPipeline via explicit PipelineMixinProtocol contract.

nodes.label: Provider Router with Fallbacks
nodes.rationale: Cross-lab diversity with automatic fallback on failure; _REGISTRY maps 70+ model IDs.

nodes.label: Dual-Stream Frontend
nodes.rationale: SSE carries all phase data and events; WebSocket is used ONLY for control signals (stop, status) to avoid double-processing.

nodes.label: Token Optimization
nodes.rationale: Phase-specific token budgets, context compression, and token-aware caching.

nodes.label: Neuro Long-Term Memory
nodes.rationale: L1/L2/L3 tiered cache with embedding search and Cohere rerank. Recall endpoint bootstraps context; Learn endpoint ingests final synthesis.

nodes.label: PipelineState Missing Synthesis Attribute
nodes.rationale: All budget preset tests fail with AttributeError: PipelineState object has no attribute synthesis. Additionally, SearXNG circuit breaker opens repeatedly during test runs.

nodes.label: E2EE Zero-Trust Security Architecture
nodes.rationale: End-to-end encryption architecture: TLS 1.3/1.2 for external traffic, internal PKI with auto-generated certificates, AES-256-GCM (Fernet) for data at-rest, MultiFernet key rotation. nodes.rationale: Benchmark measuring Pearson correlation between verbalized entropy and model uncertainty. Generates 50 random candidate distributions, computes entropy vs 1-max_prob. Asserts r >= 0.6. Tests compute_verbalized_entropy primitive.

nodes.label: VS Diversity Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Diversity benchmark comparing VS candidate diversity against direct generation across verticals. Uses pairwise Jaccard distance averaged across candidates. Asserts >= 2/3 verticals meet 1.3x diversity ratio.

nodes.label: VS Latency Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Latency benchmark comparing Verbalized Sampling vs baseline across LATENCY_SENSITIVE, BALANCED, and MAX_ACCURACY deployment profiles. Uses _MockLLM (100ms) and _MockNLI (20ms). Measures generate_with_vs() with flags enabled/disabled and writes results to vs_latency_overhead.md.

nodes.rationale: CoVE 4-step: draft claims → verification questions → independent answers → revise claims. Hostile spot-check on 20% of verified claims catches false positives.

nodes.rationale: Simplified BM25-style relevance score with title matches weighted 3x. Optimized from list.count to Counter for O(|Q|+|T|).

nodes.label: Self-Healing System
nodes.rationale: Three-loop self-healing architecture: Loop 1 (static/build-time test generation), Loop 2 (runtime observability injection), Loop 3 (evolutionary post-incident learning). Auto-apply policy is DISABLED requiring human review.

nodes.label: P1 Error Handling Fixes
nodes.rationale: All 19 P1 error handling gaps fixed across 7 files with comprehensive try/except, structured logging, and proper exception propagation. Patterns: specific exception handling, exception translation, graceful degradation, logging + re-raise.

nodes.label: Circuit Breaker Pattern
nodes.rationale: SearXNG circuit breaker prevents 30s hangs when instance is down. Config: failure_threshold=3, success_threshold=2, timeout=30s.

nodes.label: HyperGate Pre-Routing
nodes.rationale: 6 parallel sub-agents detect language, complexity, directness, web need, and optimal method before pipeline execution.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Security Pattern
nodes.rationale: Rate limiter, auth deps, quota checks, and preset access all fail closed (deny request) when underlying services raise exceptions. This is an intentional defense-in-depth design choice verified across test_auth_deps_rate_limiter, test_bugfixes_regression_round2, and test_backend_bugfixes.

nodes.label: Graceful Degradation Pattern
nodes.rationale: When optional dependencies are missing or fail (Cohere rerank, semantic retrieval, translation), the system auto-disables or falls back rather than crashing. Verified in test_auto_rollback, test_cohere_rerank, test_cross_language, and test_document_vector_store.

nodes.label: Event-Driven Architecture
nodes.rationale: The pipeline uses an in-memory EventBus with backpressure, domain events (PipelineStarted, PhaseCompleted), and an EventStore for persistence. Tests verify isolation, concurrency safety, and that subscribers are not registered at import time.

nodes.label: Circuit Breaker Resilience Pattern
nodes.rationale: LLM router wraps provider calls with circuit breaker protection. CancelledError must not poison the breaker, and HALF_OPEN state limits concurrent probes. Verified in test_circuit_breaker and test_bugfixes_regression_round3.

nodes.label: State Deserialization Robustness Tests
nodes.rationale: State deserialization must handle malformed data gracefully: missing fields use defaults, wrong types are coerced, invalid enums fallback to UNKNOWN or default values.

nodes.label: Parsing Bug Fix Tests
nodes.rationale: BUG-004: extract_json must prevent ReDoS attacks via input truncation. BUG-005: safe_list must handle dict types correctly. BUG-006: extract_solution_prose must handle empty content.

nodes.label: Persuasion Defense Pipeline Tests
nodes.rationale: Multi-stage persuasion defense pipeline with coverage audit, tactic detection, intent consistency, active friction gate, and behavioral audit. Config weights must sum to 1.0. NLI threshold set at 0.7 for verification.

nodes.label: PhaseSubAgent Base Tests
nodes.rationale: PhaseSubAgent base class provides execute caching, cost tracking per phase, graceful failure handling, and low-confidence cache exclusion.

nodes.label: Pipeline Regression Tests
nodes.rationale: Regression tests for stress test hallucination filtering, recovery path leakage prevention, sources format coercion, language detection, prompt enhancement, and search result gating.

nodes.label: Pipeline Flow Registry Tests
nodes.rationale: PipelineFlow registry supports 19 methods with critical phase halting. Critical phase failures stop sequence execution; non-critical failures allow continuation.

nodes.label: DAG Phase Execution Tests
nodes.rationale: Dependency-aware parallel phase execution using DAG topology. Supports sequential, parallel independent, and mixed serial/parallel execution with circular dependency detection.

nodes.label: HTTP Pool Cleanup Tests
nodes.rationale: Shared HTTP pool must be properly cleaned up to prevent resource leaks. Concurrent initialization must be race-free, creating only one httpx client even under concurrent instantiation.

nodes.label: Prompt Injection Defense Tests
nodes.rationale: Three-layer defense architecture: Layer 1 entry-point sanitization via Pydantic validators, Layer 2 prompt delimiters wrapping user input in explicit boundaries, Layer 3 runtime scrubbing of external content before prompt injection.

nodes.label: Quick Quality Gate Tests
nodes.rationale: QuickQualityCheck validates JSON structure for structured-output roles and applies content-quality heuristics: empty check, minimum length by role, repetition detection, and balanced code fence validation.

nodes.label: Rate Limiter Concurrency Tests
nodes.rationale: Token-bucket rate limiter with sharded locks for concurrent access. Different client buckets are isolated. Tier multipliers apply to authenticated users.

nodes.label: Regression Bug Tests
nodes.rationale: BUG-001: Neuro persist must send current turn final_solution instead of previous_synthesis. BUG-002: clear_cache must invalidate both disk files and in-memory cache. BUG-003: AuthManager.generate_key must be async-safe under concurrent access.

nodes.label: Reliability Patch Tests
nodes.rationale: Enum reconstruction resilience for malformed values, HyperGate fast-path bypass for creative frames on technical topics, and CLI resource cleanup on exit.

nodes.label: History Ownership Isolation Tests
nodes.rationale: History entries are filtered by user_id. Users cannot access or delete other users history entries. Anonymous entries are isolated.

nodes.label: Preset Tier Enforcement Tests
nodes.rationale: Free users cannot access pro-tier presets. Pro users cannot access enterprise-tier presets. Cancelled subscriptions are treated as free tier. DB unavailability defaults to free tier.

nodes.label: Redis Run State Manager Tests
nodes.rationale: Redis-backed RunStateManager with in-memory fallback. cancel_all_active uses Redis Sets. pop_cancelled is atomic via Lua script. Cross-process cancellation is supported.

nodes.label: Stop Ownership Tests
nodes.rationale: User B cannot cancel User A run. Owners can cancel their own runs. Any authenticated user can cancel anonymous runs. Global stop requires authentication.

nodes.label: Stripe Webhook Tests
nodes.rationale: Webhook returns 200 even on signature or processing errors to prevent retries. Duplicate event IDs are deduplicated via Redis. Unsigned payloads are ignored when webhook secret is missing.

nodes.label: BUG-003 IPv6 Anonymization Bypass
nodes.rationale: _anonymize_ip() used a heuristic that dropped empty IPv6 segments caused by :: compression. Addresses like 2001:db8::1 were returned unmasked, violating GDPR anonymization requirements.

nodes.label: Authentication Flow (Pass-Through Proxy)
nodes.rationale: Next.js acts as a transparent frontend layer. FastAPI handles auth via HTTPBearer. Original headers including Authorization are proxied. No secrets are exposed to the client bundle.

nodes.label: API Proxy Pattern
nodes.rationale: All /api/* routes proxy to the FastAPI backend to avoid CORS, allow future header injection for auth/rate-limiting/logging, and isolate secrets as server-side env vars.

nodes.label: Dual-Stream Frontend
nodes.rationale: SSE carries all phase data and events. WebSocket is used ONLY for control signals such as stop and status to avoid double-processing.
